name: EZ Clear核心透明流程

steps: 
  [1]     stage: delipidation
    operation: 将固定样本浸入50% THF水溶液脱脂
    conditions: 50% (v/v) THF; 20 mL; glass vial; protected from light; orbital rocking; room temperature; ventilated hood
    duration_original: 16 hr
    time_role: stage_duration

    operation: 用水漂洗四次以去除残余THF
    conditions: sterile Milli-Q H2O; 20 mL sequence wording; room temperature
    duration_original: 1 hr each ×4
    time_role: stage_duration
  [3]     stage: RI_matching
    operation: 浸入EZ View使样本透明
    conditions: 5 mL EZ View; gentle rocking; room temperature; protected from light
    duration_original: 24 hr
